summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by MINISO Group Holding Ltd to report a Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return for June 11, 2026. It discloses routine changes in issued shares, including share repurchases for cancellation of 650,000 ordinary shares at USD 3.307 per share on June 10, 2026, representing 0.0525% of existing issued shares. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is present. The filing is a standard regulatory disclosure of equity issuer share movements and buybacks under Hong Kong listing rules, with no board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms. This constitutes a routine current report.
